description: 1,000,000 randomized deliveries through the synthetic account with the COMPACT (L2.1) and FULL (full-history reference) stores; candidate limits (256 receipts or 24 h per stream); checkpoint save/restore every 10,000 deliveries; a branch with wrong-branch probes every 25,000; every declared difference reason-checked; registered budgets 30 min wall and 4 GB peak process memory, enforced (a run over budget is stopped and reported as stopped).
